Not only was it the first ever WWC World Title change in Canada, but it was Youth's first World Title win, and the first ever Three Way Dance with Stud/Kelly/Youth!"

lost.source: the next reign's own won date on the fed's own served title-history page (promotions/uga/archive/wwc-world-title-history.html)

how: Won the first-ever WWC World Title change in Canada, in the first-ever three-way dance among the Sex and Violence trio (Stud/Kelly/Youth).
note: The 17TH WWC World Champion, per the fed's own title-history page's own numbering. The page's own blow-by-blow line for this reign ("Kelly pinned Stud thirty one minutes into the match to become the new champion") CONTRADICTS its own header crediting Disturbed Youth — an inconsistency preserved verbatim in the served document, not silently corrected. Recorded here under the header's own credited champion (Disturbed Youth), on two pieces of corroborating evidence inside the same document: the same entry's own "it was Youth's first World Title win" line, and the very next (18th) reign's own text, which has Shane Stud regaining the title specifically from "his Sex and Violence friend and partner Disturbed Youth" — confirming Youth, not Kelly, held it entering that match. The full transcript of that next match (promotions/uga/archive/carnacage-8.html) independently and unambiguously bills Disturbed Youth as the defending champion throughout, settling the question from a second served document.
